findings.text: No test exercises deep-link resolution: the pendingDetail effect in useRouting (company slug resolved to selCo once loading is false, unknown slug to view '404'), the popstate handler (onPop with e.state.from), or parseURL (company/jobs/jobDetail/universal routes). useRouting.test.jsx only covers initial home view, nav('directory') and goTo('co-2'), so the deep-link half of the AC is unproven.

findings.ac: Logic Layer: create src/hooks/useAppData.js and src/hooks/useDeepLinkRouting.js
findings.text: The issue names src/hooks/useAppData.js and src/hooks/useDeepLinkRouting.js, but the code adds src/useEcosystemData.js and src/useRouting.js with no hooks/ directory. The required file names and locations are absent, and the checked box is not satisfied literally.

useEcosystemData.test.jsx covers only the isConfigured=true happy path, and asserts only companies and dataSource. Untested: the landing branch (no active region), the single-region window.location.href redirect (now using parseURL().view), the catch fallback to MOCK_COMPANIES/MOCK_JOBS ('Stuttgart'), the isConfigured=false path, and the sectorDefs/jobFuncDefs/jobs/activeRegion/region short-name outputs. Behavior-neutrality of the extraction is only partly proven.

findings.ac: AC2: filters and search queries function identically
findings.text: The issue overview says filtering state logic is extracted, but the filter and search state (sectorF, q, dF, fCo) stays in App.jsx; only reset was moved above useRouting. No test covers filters, search or reset via nav. Resetting filters on nav is checked only as a resetFilters mock call.

No test or measurement backs zero latency. The fetch effect deps changed from [] to [regionSlug], and nav is recreated every render because resetFilters (reset) is not memoized and sits in nav's useCallback deps. Neither is checked, so the AC rests on assumption.
